notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately; their individual closing order is compressed into the interval between frames 592 and 600, so those off-frame estimates are close together and less certain. scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens and later closes the refrigerator, independently opens and closes both doors of the upper cabinet above the cooktop, and then opens and closes the top drawer beside the oven.
